_what_this_is: Claims this issue takes from a source rather than establishes itself. Each records the source's ACTUAL wording and scope, so the check can compare what we wrote against what they wrote. A claim marked `quoted` may appear on the page only as a quotation or an attribution; a claim marked `established` may be asserted, and the `how_established` field says what we did beyond reading the source.
_why: Issue two took 'the CDK4/6 inhibitors have not been directly compared in clinical trials' from NCCN — a sentence about first-line aromatase-inhibitor combinations — verified that the guideline says it, then printed it as an unqualified claim about the world. Two randomised head-to-head trials existed. Verifying that a source says X is not verifying X.

claims.we_wrote: No randomised trial has compared any of the three against another
claims.source: S001 — NCCN Guidelines, Breast Cancer, v6.2026
claims.their_wording: However, the CDK4/6 inhibitors have not been directly compared in clinical trials.
claims.their_scope: The passage discussing first-line aromatase-inhibitor plus CDK4/6-inhibitor combinations. The sentence is not offered as a survey of every setting and every line of therapy, which is how this page used it.
claims.note: Verified as a quotation on 29 August, via the source advocate's question S001-04, and printed as our own unscoped assertion. A randomised phase III open-label trial of ribociclib versus palbociclib with fulvestrant (second line) was published in APJCP in 2024, and HARMONIA (NCT05207709) is a registered head-to-head phase III of the same pair. Both were found by the counterexample hunter in one call. The claim does survive for abemaciclib against either of the other two.

claims.we_wrote: the guideline lists all three as preferred first-line options
claims.source: S001 — NCCN Guidelines, Breast Cancer, v6.2026
claims.their_wording: The NCCN Panel has included CDK4/6 inhibitors in combination with AI as preferred first-line options ... Due to the clear OS benefit seen with ribociclib in combination with AI, it is a category 1 recommendation. Abemaciclib and palbociclib are both category 2A.
claims.their_scope: First-line HR+/HER2- recurrent or stage IV disease, postmenopausal patients and premenopausal patients on ovarian ablation or suppression. Confirmed by the operator across every line and subgroup in that section (advocate questions S001-01 and S001-09).
claims.note: Correctly attributed on the page throughout. This is what a quoted claim should look like.

claims.source: S005 — MONALEESA-2 overall survival, N Engl J Med, 2022
claims.their_scope: The final overall-survival analysis. The paper's statistical section — which states the direction of the test and the boundary — was never opened by anyone here.
claims.note: The page says the direction 'could not be established'. A reviewer found it on ClinicalTrials.gov's results tab for NCT01958021: the prespecified final OS analysis used a log-rank test at a one-sided cumulative 2.5% level. We searched the journal, gave up, and called the fact unknowable without ever searching the registry.
